data.body:
Plan review BLOCK on three findings, all correct.

(1) AC1 named scripts/mutation_sandbox.py as the site of the allow-list construction. Wrong: wrap() RECEIVES allow as a parameter and constructs nothing. The venv-excluding allow-list is built in scripts/mutation_gate.py:execute_shard as sandbox_allow = (root, basetemp), with sys.prefix deliberately absent. AC1 now points at the real authority.

(2 and 3, the same problem) AC3 claimed the fail-open would 'require more than ambient CI alone' while its verification asserted only warning text — a proxy for the requirement, not the requirement. The reviewer noted this left an executor unsure whether to add a real second gate or just improve the message.

Decided rather than fudged: baf9 stays an observability fix, and AC3 now says so explicitly, including that ambient CI REMAINS the sole condition after this ticket. The actual gating change is filed as f11d-f8fd (nubuck-wailsome-bronco, P2), because requiring an explicit opt-in alongside CI is a behaviour change affecting every lane that relies on the fallback and deserves its own review rather than riding along in a docs-and-messages cleanup.
